snippet.title: Infinity: HexaDome Tactics - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Infinity: HexaDome Tactics now: https://hexadomeplay.online/IskFJL

The wait is finally over! The first-ever PC video game set in the acclaimed Infinity sci-fi board game universe has officially arrived.

Step into the HexaDome, build your ultimate team of champions, and outsmart your opponents in brutal 1v1 turn-based arena tactics. Discover the HexaDome story in a single-player campaign, jump into duels, or fight in ranked PvP matches.

Grab the base game today and level up with our Day-1 DLCs, unlocking a new champion, exclusive skins, and other content with a variety of packs and bundles.
